All24 remaining original negative neighbors and47 common refusals remain, seven exact old rows remain mandatory Code1605/NONE promotions and native pairs; the exact former vl256 negative is a separate mandatory Code1604/NONE promotion with native coverage in the separately required256 cohort. No other width/mask/store/prefix, exhaustive numerical address, application completion or performance claim. Original row16 additionally requires exact Code1847/FALLTHROUGH/SIMD and full RANGE64 in a separate352-byte trailer in every success/fault record; native Code1847 coverage is a separately mandatory cohort.
